card.name: A street tree
card.note: A tree in a box at the edge of the plank walk, as the city's house streets were planted by 1871. Its spot, and the kind it is drawn as, are our reconstruction.

species.common: street tree (drawn as an American elm)
species.note: Carbutt's No. 139 looks down Washington Street past the opera house to a street of tall, broad-crowned trees, and the Court House stereograph shows the square's trees; neither picture names the kind. Every street tree is drawn as the American elm the 1904 layer grows.

placement.note: On the house streets within about 3.2 km of State and Madison: one file a side at about 30 ft, 0.55 m in from the kerb, clear of the corners, with about one place in three empty and one tree in five young, as a city planting its streets for twenty years would show. Reconstructed.
